title: TEFCA IAS SOP v3.0 -- SHOULD / RECOMMENDED layer (UNOFFICIAL)
description: Each def = the MUST-layer def + the generic OIDC RECOMMENDED delta + TEFCA SHOULD/RECOMMENDED items. Passing here implies passing the MUST layer; tools should report errors that appear ONLY here as warnings. Custom annotation keywords: x-precedence, one of: inherited (a base rule applying unchanged, e.g. QTF via IAS §4.2(a) or Facilitated FHIR/SSRAA via IAS §4.2(b)); profile-tightened (a compatible narrowing of a base rule; satisfying the profile satisfies both); explicit-override (a source text expressly replaces a base rule); superseded (an explicitly replaced deadline); unresolved-conflict (incompatible texts with no override; needs governing-priority interpretation or RCE clarification). Requirements are cumulative where compatible; genuine conflicts are never resolved by picking the apparently stricter rule. x-obligation (REQUIRED, MUST, SHALL, CONDITIONAL, MUST-IF-VERIFIED, MUST-ONE-OF, SHOULD, RECOMMENDED, MAY, OPTIONAL) and x-source (spec section). Draft 2020-12 validators collect unknown keywords as annotations; Ajv strict mode needs ajv.addKeyword() for each, or strict:false. x-not-expressible lists rules of that definition no JSON Schema can enforce. *Delta definitions (addressDelta, idTokenClaimsDelta) hold only the SHOULD/RECOMMENDED items, without the MUST layer, so they apply under both the SOP-text reading and QHIN Compliance Bulletin No. 2.

addressDelta.description: SHOULD/RECOMMENDED address items only (no MUST constraints), so they can be applied to an address object or to each element of a Bulletin 2 historical_address array.

tefca_ial2claims_version.description: SOP-text reading: presence SHOULD (§4.9(a)(iv)). Production requires presence and the value '3.0' in the MUST layer, so this entry only records the SOP obligation.

idTokenClaimsDelta.x-source: heuristic (OIDC Core §5.1; QHIN Compliance Bulletin No. 2 §3(e)-(f))
idTokenClaimsDelta.description: TEFCA SHOULD/RECOMMENDED items only, without the MUST layer, so the same items apply under the SOP-text reading and under QHIN Compliance Bulletin No. 2. dependentRequired: a *_verified flag without the claim it qualifies is defined by neither OIDC nor the Bulletin (Bulletin §3(e)-(f) speak of a flag accompanying its claim); omit it.

idTokenClaims.description: SOP-text reading: MUST layer + generic OIDC RECOMMENDED + TEFCA SHOULD items. For the Bulletin 2 reading use urn:x-tefca-qhin-bulletin-2:1.0:schema#/$defs/idTokenClaimsRecommended.

idTokenHeader.description: No SHOULD items beyond the MUST layer.
